title: lithospermum cyrousianum
intro: Lithospermum cyrousianum, commonly known as Iranian gentian, is a plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Lithospermum cyrousianum include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit potential anticancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
